MAGPlot 2.0's compiled specification

Source: R/magp_spec.R
magp_spec.Rd

The specification object for MAGPlot 2.0, compiled from the dated specification files named in its manifest.

Usage

magp_spec()

Value

An object of class gpq_spec, as gpq_read_spec() returns.

Examples

spec <- magp_spec()
spec$manifest
#>                                input                                      file
#>                               <char>                                    <char>
#>  1:                       dictionary                   20261005_magpv2_DD.xlsx
#>  2:                       code_lists        20261005_magpv2_Lookup_Tables.xlsx
